definitions.gloss: team member; member of a team
definitions.explanation: A person who belongs to a team, whether in sports, business, or a project group. A compound loanword from English "team" and "member".

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいチームメンバーを{紹介|しょうかい}する。
examples.english: I'll introduce the new team member.

examples.japanese: チームメンバーと{意見|いけん}を{出|だ}し{合|あ}った。
examples.english: I exchanged opinions with my team members.

examples.japanese: プロジェクトの{成功|せいこう}は、{一人|ひとり}ひとりのチームメンバーの{努力|どりょく}にかかっている。
examples.english: The success of the project depends on the effort of each individual team member.

notes:
A loanword compound of "team" ({チーム}) and "member" (メンバー). Very common in business and project contexts; the native equivalent {一員|いちいん} sounds more formal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チームメンバーを{募集|ぼしゅう}する: to recruit team members
- チームメンバーと{協力|きょうりょく}する: to cooperate with team members
- チームメンバーの{一人|ひとり}: one of the team members

SIMILAR WORDS:
- メンバー: member — the general term; チームメンバー specifies membership in a team.
- {一員|いちいん}: a member (of a group) — more formal and native-sounding.
